## 1. Exact order

**Confirmed:** Services is immediately after Stats in `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\homepage.json`.

| Order | `id` | `type` |
|-------|------|--------|
| … | `stats` | `stats` |
| **next** | **`services`** | **`services`** |
| then | `creative-showcase` | `creativeShowcase` |

Also Verified in `docs\qa\VERIFICATION-LOG.md` (section order line) and plan IA: `stats → services → creative`.

---

## 2. Full `data` object (`homepage.json`)

Heading / subheading already match B4 locked chrome.

| # | Title | href | icon | Desc length |
|---|--------|------|------|-------------|
| 01 | Amazon Account Management | `/full-service-amazon-agency/` | briefcase | ~24 words, 2 sentences |
| 02 | PPC Management | `/amazon-ppc-management-agency/` | target | ~23 words, 2 sentences |
| 03 | Listing Optimization and SEO | `/amazon-listing-optimization/` | search | ~24 words, 2 sentences |
| 04 | Content Writing | `/amazon-content-writing/` | file-text | ~24 words, 2 sentences |

Copy text is the B4 locked table (Seller Central oversight, SP/SB/SD, keyword/listing SEO, titles/bullets/A+, main/secondary/A+ visuals, suppressions/variations). Not huge — full object is lines 272–319 of `homepage.json`.

---

## 3. Implementation

**Path:** `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\sections\services-section.tsx`  
**Wired via:** `homepage-section-renderer.tsx` (`case "services"`)

| Aspect | Current |
|--------|---------|
| Layout | `SectionShell` (default tone — **not** `muted`) → `SectionHeading` → `<ul>` grid `md:2` / `lg:3` |
| Cards | `ElegantCard` `h-full bg-background`; padding `p-6` |
| Per card | Quiet mono number (top-right) → framed Lucide via `SectionIcon` → H3 → body → link |
| CTA | `Button variant="link"`: visible **“Learn more”** + `ArrowRight`; `aria-label={`Learn more about ${title}`}` |
| Icons | Lucide map in `section-icon.tsx` (`framed`: accent tile border/bg) |

---

## 4. Part B4 plan (`.cursor/plans/homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md`)

**Status in plan:** **LOCKED** (todo `section-detail-services`; Part B header “B4 … — LOCKED”). Early master table still says “IMPROVE” for copy — that work is done; B4 supersedes as locked.

**Goal:** Six core Amazon capabilities as a scannable **3×2** grid with depth (not one-liners), dedicated URLs, MAG/SalesDuo clarity without AMZ Dudes 09-item overwhelm.

**Locked decisions (summary):**
1. Keep six services + current hrefs  
2. Deepen to 2 sentences (~25–40 words) — **done in JSON**  
3. Optional quiet `01`–`06` — **done**  
4. Keep Lucide; **no** stock photos on cards  
5. CTA “Learn more” + title in `aria-label` — **done**  
6. Heading “Amazon growth services” (reject “Pro-level”) — **done**  
7. Whole-card click = nice-to-have only  

**Gaps vs current code:**

| Spec | Code |
|------|------|
| “muted band” shell | **Gap:** no `tone="muted"` on `SectionShell` (default) |
| Locked copy / numbers / Lucide / hrefs / Learn more | **Aligned** |
| Visual density / motifs | **Not in B4 lock**; still open polish (see QA) |

**Reject list:** “cut the fluff”, “Pro-level”, “Unlock higher visibility” hype, hash-only `/services/#…` links, emoji icons; also out of scope: DSP/TikTok/Shopify/sourcing in this six-pack, creative portfolio (B5), 09-item mega list.

---

## 5. Competitor patterns (`docs\seo\COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`)

| Competitor | Services-grid pattern | Plan adopt / skip |
|------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **My Amazon Guy** | 4-pillar grid: icon, title, short desc, link | Adopt card anatomy; skip limiting to 4 |
| **AMZ Dudes** | Numbered 01–09 list | Adopt quiet 01–06; skip nine shallow + emoji |
| **SalesDuo** | Channel / agency-type segmentation | Clear boundaries; skip “AI-powered” inflation |
| **Canopy** | Filterable case grid by service (cases page) | Cases, not homepage services |
| **Sequence** | Multi-level services mega menu | Nav, not homepage six-pack |

Takeaways elsewhere: numbered services + seller segmentation (Dudes); FAQ/trust density (MAG); avoid emoji and unverified scale claims.

---

## 6. Recent visual audit notes (`docs\qa\`)

**`docs\qa\HOMEPAGE-VISUAL-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md`:**
- Services = **Low** visual density; “Lucide icons + text cards”; gap = **“flat SaaS grid”**; priority **P1**
- Root cause: icon+copy **by lock**; competitors use photography/illustrated process
- Proposed polish (needs go-ahead): optional small illustration or muted motif per card / shared capability strip — **not** random stock photos

**`docs\qa\VERIFICATION-LOG.md` (2026-09-08 Stats entry):**  
**NEXT ACTION:** Services section when Stats signed off visually by user.

**`docs\ai\SESSION-STATE.md`:** next homepage section when user advances = Services.

---

## LOCKED vs still IMPROVE/polish

| LOCKED (do not reopen without decision) | Still IMPROVE / polish |
|----------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Six services, titles, hrefs, icons | Optional `tone="muted"` vs default shell |
| 2-sentence locked descriptions | Visual density (“flat SaaS”) — motifs / shared strip |
| Lucide only; no stock on cards | Whole-card clickable (nice-to-have) |
| Heading/subheading chrome | User visual sign-off before deeper polish |
| Reject slang / hash links / emoji | Extra services stay in mega menu/footer only |

**Bottom line:** B4 content + IA are **LOCKED and largely shipped**. Remaining Services work is **visual polish**, not structure/copy rewrite.
